pages.text: You can now make some pretty badass $(item)Machinery$()! Good Job!$(br2)Now you might want something a bit more robust for $(item)Power Generation$(), a solid option at this point would be the $(item)Thermoelectric Generator$()$(br2)The $(item)Thermoelectric Generator$() mixes hot & cold liquids together to create power.

pages.title: Thermoelectric Mats
pages.notes: Don't forget to use $(l:portal_hub/4_schematica)Schematica$() if you're unsure of how to build the multiblock.$(br2)A redstone signal will stop the machine from consuming liquid.

pages.title: Industrial Power
pages.text: To see all of the $(item)Hot$() and $(item)Cold$() liquid combinations that produces $(item)Power$(), check out the uses of the Machine Blueprint$(br)(This item is not required to use the $(item)Generator$())$(br2)$(item)Hardened Fluiducts$() are recommended for handling hot & cold fluids.

pages.title: Alternative power
pages.text: If you're not so keen on the $(item)Thermoelectric Generator$() and you don't mind the automation challenge. You can make $(item)Biodiesel$() in a $(item)Refinery$(), then feed it to $(item)Diesel Generator$() multiblocks (Under Immersive Engineering in $(l:portal_hub/4_schematica)Schematica$()). Though you might need a lot of $(item)Garden Cloches$() to sustain it.$(br2)Remember that $(item)Garden Cloches$() can grow crops faster when combining fluid fertilizers with item fertilizers.

pages.title: Alternative power
pages.text: One good $(item)Garden Cloche$() amplifier at this point is solid $(item)Fertilizer$(). Made by composting sewage, which can be obtained from the $(item)Animal Sewer$().$(br2)$(item)Melons$() are a good source of $(item)Ethanol$() and $(item)Pumpkin seeds$() are a good source of $(item)Plant Oil$().

pages.title: Alternative power
pages.text: $(item)Melons$() can be turned into $(item)Melon slices$() by slicing them in the $(item)Metal Press$() multiblock, or by placing them in the world and breaking them.$(br2)This can be automated with the $(l:sim_2/helpful_stuff#night_ritual)Mechanical user$() and $(item)Mechanical Miner$().
